children: Miele, who took over as CEO in August 2024, purchased the shares at an average price of 1.38p each, for a total value of £9,660.
Following the purchase, Miele holds a beneficial interest in 7.9m ordinary Genedrive shares, representing approximately 0.49% of the company's issued share capital.
As of 1415 BST, Genedrive shares were up 7.14% at 1.50p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
